description: 43-band spectral film emulation engine with multiple film stock presets and full GPU acceleration.
_tagComment: releaseTagPattern pins this catalog entry to the 2.x line. The same release repo also hosts the PhotoChemist 3.0 Beta line (v3.* tags, PhotoChemist3Beta-* assets) served by docs/plugins/photochemist3beta/. Without this filter the newest v3 prerelease would become this entry's beta head and its assets would (partially) match the loose patterns below.
_demoComment: NO demo block on this entry by design. The watermarked demo is built from the 3.0 beta line and installs as PhotoChemist3Beta.ofx.bundle / com.dec18studios.PhotoChemist3Beta, so it is served by docs/plugins/photochemist3beta/ instead. It cannot be served from here: apply_demo_override() in installer.rs swaps only downloadUrl/sha256/version, while bundleName still comes from the assetRules below (PhotoChemist.ofx.bundle) — pointing this entry at the 3.0 demo zip would stage a bundle name that is not in the archive and fail at install. Unlicensed users on this 2.x entry get the sign-in prompt (main.js handles the no-demoAvailable path).
